comments.headline: South adjacent property missing zoning and land use labels
comments.summary: The south SF-3 adjacent property is missing critical documentation on the site plan: zoning designation (SF-3), land use label, and zoning district boundary. This property triggers Subchapter F compatibility standards and must be fully documented to assess compatibility impact.
comments.attn: SF-3 zoning triggers Subchapter F stricter compatibility standards (confirmed in facts.md as parcel 0406100210). Verify zoning designation accuracy against City GIS records.

details.text: South adjacent property labeled 'Single Family' use without specific property identification or zoning designation on site plan.

runComments.comment: Adjoining land uses not documented on all sides. South side shows 'Single Family' use without specific property identification. West side (Valley View Road street frontage) does not identify land uses across the street. East and north sides are labeled but incomplete documentation of all surrounding properties on all four sides.

Adjoining land uses not labeled on the main site plan for north and south adjacent properties. Sheet 9 shows zoning for north but does not indicate land use, and south property has no zoning or land use designation. Main site plan must document all adjacent uses on all four sides.

details.text: Adjacent land uses for south SF-3 parcel not identified with any land use designation or zoning label on site plan.

runComments.comment: Adjacent land uses not labeled on site plan. The SF-3 property to the south (which triggers compatibility standards per facts.md) is not identified with any land use designation. While zoning is labeled for north (MF-4-CO) and east (MF-2-CO) adjacent properties, the south property has no land use label.

details.text: Adjacent property zoning district designation (SF-3) not shown for south side despite triggering compatibility requirements.

runComments.comment: Adjacent property zoning district designations not shown on all sides. South side property is labeled with 'Use: Single Family' but no zoning designation is provided for this adjacent property. Zoning must be shown for all surrounding properties to verify compatibility requirements.
Adjacent property zoning designation not shown on main site plan for south property. East and north adjacent zoning are labeled on Sheet 9, but south property has no zoning designation displayed.

details.text: South adjacent property zoning designation (SF-3) not displayed on main site plan despite triggering Subchapter F compatibility standards.

runComments.comment: Adjacent property zoning designation not shown on site plan. The south adjacent property (identified in facts.md as SF-3 parcel 0406100210 triggering Subchapter F compatibility standards) has no zoning label. While MF-4-CO is labeled to the north and MF-2-CO to the east, the critical SF-3 designation is absent from the south property.

details.text: Zoning district boundary (SF-3 zone to the south) not shown or labeled on site plan despite being adjacent to site.

runComments.comment: Zoning district boundary not shown or labeled for all adjacent zones. The site abuts MF-2, MF-4-CO, MF-2-CO, and SF-3 zoning districts. While north (MF-4-CO) and east (MF-2-CO) are labeled, the SF-3 zone boundary to the south is not shown or labeled.

comments.headline: Adjacent building footprints and vacancy documentation incomplete
comments.summary: Building footprints on adjacent properties within the 50-foot vicinity are not fully documented on the site plan. North and south sides show no building footprints; south property appears vacant but lacks required notation. Building documentation requirements and mandatory "no buildings" notation are missing.
comments.attn: Clarify whether buildings exist on north MF-4-CO and south SF-3 adjacent properties. If no buildings within 50 feet, add required notation for each side.

details.text: Vacant south adjacent property not labeled with required 'VACANT' notation on site plan drawing.

runComments.comment: Vacant adjoining property not identified as vacant on site plan. The south adjacent property shows no building footprints or structures on the drawing and appears to be vacant, but is not labeled with the required notation 'VACANT'.

details.text: Required notation 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet' absent for north and south sides where no building footprints are shown.

runComments.comment: Required note absent when no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet. North and south adjacent properties are shown without building footprints, but the site plan does not include the required notation: 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet.' If buildings exist on these properties, they must be depicted; if not, a required clarifying note must be added.

Verification note absent stating whether buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet. Site plan must include note for each side where no buildings exist stating 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet.'

details.text: Verification of required notation for each side of property line absent. Site plan must clarify building existence on all four sides or state required 'no buildings' notation.

runComments.comment: Required note absent when no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet. The south adjacent property shows no structures on the site plan and appears to be vacant. If no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet, the site plan must include a note stating 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet'. This note is not present.

details.text: Existing building footprints on adjoining properties within 50 feet not completely shown. East side shows existing 4-story apartment building; north and south sides show no building footprints, documentation is incomplete or ambiguous.

runComments.comment: Existing building footprints on adjoining properties within 50 feet may not be completely shown. East side shows existing apartment buildings in dashed outline with annotations ('Existing 4-Story Brick Apt. Bldg.' height 45'-10"). North and south sides show no building footprints, but it is unclear whether buildings exist on these adjacent properties and are simply not depicted or whether no buildings exist. Documentation is incomplete or ambiguous.

Building footprints on adjoining properties within 50 feet are not clearly confirmed on main site plan for north and south sides. East side footprints are shown, but north and south adjacent building footprints are not clearly depicted on Sheet 9.

details.text: North adjacent MF-4-CO property likely has buildings within 50 feet but none depicted on site plan; north and south building footprints must be shown if they exist within vicinity.

runComments.comment: Existing building footprints on adjoining properties within 50 feet not shown on site plan. The east adjacent property shows 'Existing Apartment Building' labeled and depicted. However, the north adjacent property (MF-4-CO zoning) shows no building footprints within the 50-foot vicinity, though buildings likely exist on this multi-family parcel; footprints must be shown if they are within 50 feet of the site boundary.

comments.headline: Land uses across Valley View Road not documented

comments.attn: Determine whether across-street land use documentation is required for your jurisdiction's standard site plan practice.

Land uses for properties across Valley View Road (west of the public right-of-way) are not documented on the site plan. Properties on the opposite side of the street should have their land uses identified and labeled.

comments.attn: Resolve discrepancy between Sheet 9 (north zoning MF-4-CO) and Sheet 11 (MF-2-CO). Provide mylar/plat documents with current zoning designations and verify all adjacent zoning against current City GIS records before approval.

details.text: Zoning discrepancy exists: Sheet 9 shows north adjacent property as MF-4-CO while Sheet 11 shows MF-2-CO; north property also noted on facts.md as adjacent SF-3 parcel. Accuracy cannot be verified against City GIS records.

runComments.comment: Adjacent zoning designations shown on site plan cannot be verified against current City GIS records. North property shown as 'MF-2-CO' but facts.md indicates adjacent SF-3 parcel (ID 0406100210). East side properties shown as 'MF-2-CO' with 'Claerain Ridge Condominiums' labeling. Zoning accuracy requires independent GIS confirmation.

Discrepancy exists between sheet documentation: Sheet 9 shows north zoning as MF-4-CO while Sheet 11 shows MF-2-CO. Cannot verify accuracy against City GIS records. Confirm correct zoning designation.

comments.headline: Exterior lighting above second floor lacks explicit restriction
comments.summary: Exterior lighting above the second floor is not explicitly restricted on the site plan when located adjacent to residential property. Current site plan notes reference compliance with Subchapter E lighting standards but do not state the required prohibition on above-2nd-floor exterior lighting for locations adjacent to residential uses.
comments.crossDep: Architecture/building design to provide detailed luminaire schedule and locations above second floor.
comments.attn: Site is surrounded by residential zoning on all sides (MF-2, MF-3, MF-4-CO, SF-3). Explicit note restricting above-2nd-floor exterior lighting when adjacent to residential required per Subchapter E (Lighting) compatibility standards.

details.text: Individual luminaire locations and orientations above the second floor are not shown on the site plan. Sheet 9 notes state site lighting will be reviewed during building plan review, but compliance with above-2nd-floor restriction cannot be verified from submitted site plan.
details.citation: General Site Plan Notes (Compatibility); Subchapter E 2.5

runComments.comment: Exterior lighting above the second floor is not verified to be absent where facing adjacent residential property. Sheet 9 notes state that 'All site lighting to be located on the building will be in compliance with Subchapter E 2.5 and will be reviewed during building plan review.' Individual luminaire locations and orientations above the second floor are not shown on the site plan. Compliance cannot be verified from submitted site plan; requires architectural/building elevation review.

Documentation does not explicitly restrict exterior lighting above the second floor when facing or adjacent to residential properties. Provide note or detail confirming above-2nd-floor lighting restriction for locations adjacent to residential uses.

details.text: Site plan notes require full cut-off and shielding per Subchapter E 2.5 but do not explicitly state the required prohibition: exterior lighting above the second floor is not permitted when adjacent to residential property.
details.citation: General Site Plan Notes (Compatibility); Subchapter E 2.5

runComments.comment: Exterior lighting above the second floor restriction not explicitly stated on site plan. The plan includes a note requiring full cut-off and shielding per Subchapter E 2.5, but does not explicitly state the General Site Plan Notes requirement that exterior lighting above the second floor is prohibited when adjacent to residential property. This restriction must be explicitly documented.

comments.headline: Mechanical equipment noise specifications not documented
comments.summary: Mechanical equipment noise level specifications are absent from the site plan. No equipment schedule with dB(A) manufacturer ratings is provided to demonstrate compliance with the 70 dB(A) maximum at property lines adjacent to residential uses.
comments.crossDep: Mechanical/HVAC engineer to provide equipment schedule with manufacturer noise ratings at property line distance.
comments.attn: LDC § 25-2-1063(B) requires mechanical equipment noise not exceed 70 dB(A) at property line adjacent to residential uses. Provide detailed equipment schedule with manufacturer dB(A) ratings.

details.text: No mechanical equipment schedule or noise specifications (dB(A)) at property lines are provided on site plan. Requirement applies to all sites with mechanical equipment adjacent to residential: noise may not exceed 70 dB(A) at property line. Compliance cannot be verified without equipment schedule and noise ratings.

runComments.comment: Mechanical equipment noise level not demonstrated. No mechanical equipment schedule or noise specifications (dB(A)) at property lines adjacent to residential uses are provided on the site plan. Requirement applies to all sites with mechanical equipment adjacent to residential: noise may not exceed 70 dB(A) at the property line. Compliance cannot be verified without equipment schedule and noise ratings.

Mechanical equipment noise level specifications not documented. No equipment schedule with manufacturer dB(A) ratings provided to demonstrate compliance with 70 dB(A) limit at property line adjacent to residential uses. Provide mechanical equipment schedule with noise ratings.

details.text: Equipment schedule with manufacturer dB(A) specifications absent from submitted documentation. Schedule must demonstrate compliance with 70 dB(A) noise limit at property line adjacent to residential uses.

No mechanical equipment schedule or manufacturer specifications demonstrating noise levels at or below 70 dB(A) at the property line adjacent to residential uses are available in the reviewed site plan sheets. An equipment schedule with noise ratings at property line distances must be provided.

comments.headline: Parking screening and refuse requirements incomplete
comments.summary: Two on-site compatibility elements lack full documentation. East side residential parking requires a minimum 6-foot height-specified screening fence when abutting adjacent residential property (MF-2-CO), but fence height is not specified. Trash receptacle location is not identified on site plan to verify required 20-foot setback from SF-5 or more restrictive zoning.
comments.crossDep: Landscape architect to specify fence height on plan; site design to show refuse receptacle location on site plan.
comments.attn: East side privacy fence (H.6) abuts adjacent MF-2-CO residential property; LDC § 25-6-563(B) requires minimum 6-foot height. Specify height on landscape or site plan. Dumpster location not identified; verify 20-foot setback from more restrictive zoning applies.

details.text: East side residential parking (88 spaces: 10 surface + 78 garage) abuts adjacent MF-2-CO residential property. Wooden privacy fence (H.6) shown but HEIGHT not specified on landscape plan or site plan; LDC § 25-6-563(B) requires minimum 6-foot height. Compliance cannot be verified without height documentation.

runComments.comment: Residential parking (88 spaces: 10 surface + 78 garage) screening requirements cannot be fully verified. East adjacent property is zoned/used as Multi-Family (MF-2-CO residential). If this parking abuts the adjacent residential property, a wall, fence, or landscape screen at least 6 feet in height is required (LDC § 25-6-563(B)). Site plan shows wooden privacy fence on east side (H.6) but the HEIGHT of this fence is not specified on either the landscape plan or site plan. Compliance cannot be verified without fence height documentation.

details.text: Dumpster or permanently placed refuse receptacle location not identified on site plan. Cannot verify 20-foot setback requirement from properties zoned or used as SF-5 or more restrictive (LA, RR, SF-1, SF-2, SF-3, SF-4A, SF-4B, SF-5). Sheet 9 references trash collection but does not depict refuse receptacle location on drawing.

runComments.comment: Dumpster or permanently placed refuse receptacle location not identified on site plan to verify 20-foot setback from properties zoned or used as SF-5 or more restrictive (LA, RR, SF-1, SF-2, SF-3, SF-4A, SF-4B, SF-5). Sheet 9 references trash collection requirements but does not depict the location of refuse receptacles on the site plan drawing. Compliance cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Building definition missing dimension callouts and perimeter boundaries
comments.summary: Building dimension callouts (length × width) and continuous perimeter boundary lines including roofline and attached canopies are not shown on the actual site plan drawings. Tabular building data appears on Sheet 9, but specific dimension callouts must appear on the drawing itself per BCM 1.2.7 site plan standards.
comments.attn: BCM 1.2.7 requires dimension callouts and roofline/canopy perimeter definition on the drawing, not only in summary tables. Revise site plan to show complete perimeter boundary and dimension callouts for all building footprints.

details.text: Building dimension callouts (length × width) not shown on site plan drawing. Tabular building data (gross floor area, coverage, heights) provided in tables on Sheet 9, but specific dimension callouts must be shown on the actual drawing.

Tabular building data (gross floor area, coverage, heights) is provided in tables on Sheet 9, but specific dimension callouts (length × width) on the actual drawing itself cannot be verified from the available documentation. Dimension callouts must be shown on the drawing, not only in tables.

details.text: Continuous perimeter boundary lines including roofline and attached canopies not clearly shown on site plan drawing for Buildings 1-8. Complete perimeter definition including roofline cannot be confirmed from submitted documentation.

The site plan drawing shows building layouts and outlines, but the specific requirement for a complete continuous perimeter boundary line that includes roofline and any attached canopies cannot be confirmed from the available documentation; detailed examination of the drawing would be required.
